review_notes: I read the whole file (58 lines). It has four short theorems. Only `planar_reference_mean_nonneg` has a non-trivial argument: it shifts by an antipodal rotation at one vertex and uses translation invariance of the integral. `planar_antipode_exists`, `planarCos_add_antipode` and `planar_edge_mean_nonneg` are short or thin wrappers, and none of them repeats another proof's reasoning. I grepped lean/OAI/Probability for the antipode helpers and for the `Function.update (fun _ => 0)` shift construction. No other proof in the directory repeats this reasoning; the one hit, in LatticeSurface/CapWeld.lean, is an unrelated use of `Function.update`. Other uses of `integral_add_left_eq_self` across the repo are unrelated one-line translation steps. I did not read PlanarGinibre or other ClassicalON files in full, so a duplicate there is still possible but I found no evidence of one.
